title: Research consolidation: reconcile archived R714 local replay (no new kappa)
body:
The historical hierarchy note leaves candidate-201's independent local replay pending, while the later R714 archive records it as completed. This research consolidation binds the records and independently replays the two distinct words behind the `RAW`, `MIXED` and `RETIMED` receipts. The retiming made zero moves.

The standalone checker binds all 425 archived cases, checks the 954-input F2 map and exact rational frame accounting for the R714 payloads, and rejects nine negative controls. A separate forward implementation confirms both maps; deleting compensation demonstrates why clean-helper checks alone are insufficient. The 40 later kernel trials receive ledger-coverage checks only.

Base: `2921874911956718fcaaaf9396fe8267b3cfa9f0`; assignment seed 97. No selected frontier or archived source is changed, and no new kappa, native execution, hosting result or full theorem is claimed.

Validation: the package checker with `--check`, four focused tests, the existing archive validator and selected-record check. See the package README for the exact commands, pins, scope and predecessor credit.

Hanson Sun (bbMisk), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; Emulate prose style pass independently checked for factual fidelity.
